disclaimer: Anti-cheat systems and native-Mac availability change over time. Every entry records when it was last reviewed and where the claim comes from. Native-Mac status is verified against Steam's own platform data where the game is sold there; note that Steam only knows about Steam, so a few titles ship Mac versions through the Mac App Store instead. EasyPlay never invents a rating: a game with no known blocker is reported as untested, not as working.
